_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
DAQ shared timing fields now use Python synchronization, removing that worker's Qt locker conversion. Caught acquisition failures retain full Python tracebacks, thread/device/channel context and the last native sample index in NI error journals. Terminal failures also reach the mirrored process logs when no native recorder is available.

Validation: 244 focused/broader tests, seven project checks, clean GUI layout and smoke. Passive real NI acquisition retained 59,940 samples on each of three 500 Hz channels with byte-identical mirrors and no gaps, backtracks or errors during concurrent timing updates and Qt object operations. Fault injection verifies the removed interface dependency and improved evidence; the historical October 18 native access violation still has no proven causal stack.

Firmware remains rev27v-followup-351. Calibration, saved profiles, pressure control and the accepted settling/deflation policies are unchanged. The large-cuff operating matrix remains failed qualification; no partial SysID model is adopted.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
